## Invitations

A total of 472 people were invited during the reporting period. Of these, 84 attended, giving an attendance rate of 17.8 per cent. The result indicates that fewer than one in five invitees attended. Attendance figures have been recorded against the number invited to provide a clear basis for monitoring outreach activity and participation.

The outreach arrangements were maintained in areas where access was practicable. Van days were kept where roads allowed, supporting continued delivery despite local travel constraints. This approach enabled the service to retain an outreach presence while recognising the limits imposed by road conditions.

## Contact

No invitations were sent by SMS. The SMS total was 0. No reminder messages were issued, and the recorded reminder total was 0. These contact methods were therefore not used to supplement the invitation process during the period.
